name: worker-routing
description: Instruction-only worker routing with autonomous delivery and optional finite ACP batches.

interface.shortDescription: Route bounded work to native or ACP workers.
interface.longDescription: Delegate complete responsibilities to an authorized native or ACP worker, keep ordinary self-check and repair inside that worker, collect evidence and expand finite independent batches when useful.
capabilities: Optional finite batches and evidence delivery
interface.defaultPrompt: Route this task between the main agent and configured workers.
